mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) above 2% month-over-month signals a strong supply-side response, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% year-over-year, the combination signals a potential overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) below 100,000 new jobs per month signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units per month signals strong demand in the housing market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% year-over-year and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a weakening supply-side economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
